meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会把你的 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮箱：复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、验证构建，然后引导你填好 API 密钥、发件地址等。配置好后会向你的邮箱发封问候邮件，之后就能用邮箱和它聊天。
howto.when: 当你说要给 NanoClaw 加邮件（Resend）渠道，或表达想用邮箱和它联系时，就会执行这个流程。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件渠道。
say.note: 会开始复制适配器并引导你填写 Resend 账号信息。

say.text: 我想用邮箱和 NanoClaw 聊天，添加上邮件支持吧。
say.note: 会带你完成 Resend 配置和 owner 设置。

say.text: 用 bot@my-domain.com 作为发件地址，把我的邮箱设为收件人。
say.note: 会配置发件人并给你发一封问候邮件。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw: it copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned package, builds/tests, prompts for credentials, then sends a hello email to enable email chatting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add email/Resend to NanoClaw or say you want to talk to it by email.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and asks for your Resend info.

say_en.text: I want to chat with NanoClaw by email, so add email support.
say_en.note: Walks you through Resend setup and owner wiring.

say_en.text: Use bot@my-domain.com as sender and my email as owner.
say_en.note: Sets sender/owner and sends a hello email to you.
